title: The underworld in the Kalmyk epic Jangar
summary: Russian Republic tells of The underworld in the Kalmyk epic Jangar, about ancient, millennia old at Kalmykia, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And in the Jungre epic, the underworld is described. How creatures live there, how they communicate, how they come to the surface.

plain: The president of a Russian republic, interviewed by a podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to Jangar, the old epic poem of the Kalmyk people of Kalmykia in southern Russia. He says the epic describes an underworld: the creatures that live there, how they communicate and how they come up to the surface. If he is right, it would suggest that ancient tradition remembers beings living beneath the earth.
